name: AHR_gated
description: vm-00007: the basic agent with the hindsight hunger input and replay (vm-00006 A+H+R: eps 0.2, batch 8, memory 100k), with a gated memory: a short-term buffer of the last 256 steps, and a long-term memory of 8-step chunks that enter it when they lead to hunger relief, when they were surprising (the model's prediction of the next frame, drives and move was unusually wrong), or by a draw. Arms set online.store_*; the defaults store everything (the uniform control).
